scenarios.name: Decline replacing an existing part during first save

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its existing part files
a confirmation identifies the existing file and asks whether to replace it
the confirmation offers Yes and No
the Save As dialog remains behind the confirmation
Save As remains open with the existing file name displayed
the new unsaved part remains active
